children: World Acceptance Corp. promoted John Calmes Jr. to its top role.
Calmes, 46 years old, previously served as the finance company's chief financial and strategy officer, as well as its treasurer. Scott McIntyre, 50 years old, will succeed Calmes as CFO.
Prior to joining World Acceptance in 2013, Calmes served as director of finance for corporate and investment banking at Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi UFJ, and previously as a senior manager at PwC.
World Acceptance Chairman Ken Bramlett Jr. said Calmes has the respect of the organization and will be able to hit the ground running in the new role.

As CEO, Calmes will receive a base salary of $600,000 annually. He will be eligible for an annual bonus worth up to 100% of his base salary, with a guaranteed bonus of $300,000 for fiscal 2027, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission Monday.
